messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate from runtime-pool-3 detected. Error spike started at 1784320942, current 5xx rate 6.2% over last 5m. Paging oncall.
Sam L (SRE): I’m on it. pulling logs + checking scaling. tagging @Maria G
Maria G (oncall): oncall here. what's the impact surface? customers or internal only?
Sam L (SRE): initial triage: small subset of hosted API keys seeing high token/throughput (long streaming sessions). gateway queue growth -> upstream GPU backpressure -> 503s. Affects users who do long streaming + no prefix caching.
Raj P (Devex): reaching out to devex to prepare SDK guidance. we should consider client-side mitigations first to avoid massive infra churn.
Aisha (Support): we already have 3 inbound tickets from customers reporting aborted streams. customers include two startups on dedicated bursts. putting them on the incident list.
Sam L (SRE): mitigation options:
  1) Soft throttle by applying per-key rate limit (gateway) for the offending keys (10% cutoff) - quick.
  2) Adjust routing to fallback to smaller model variant for these keys.
  3) Ask clients to reduce concurrency/retries and add idempotency keys.
  4) Disable streaming for affected keys (non-breaking but UX change).
Maria G (oncall): I'm going to apply a temporary per-key quota cap at the gateway for top 5 offenders. will post when live. aim: reduce 75% of offending tail.
Devex-Bot: Creating draft SDK advisory note in #devex-distro.patches
Raj P (Devex): Draft guidance — short and prescriptive. keep code snippets minimal. plan to push an emergency patch to Node+Python SDKs changing default retry/backoff for 48h.
Aisha (Support): Provide canned response to affected customers: explain we're throttling to stabilize, include recommended client changes.
Sam L (SRE): Maria, please confirm when gateway caps applied.
Maria G (oncall): caps applied at 1784321120. preliminary drop in queue length observed. 5xx down to 3.1%.
Sam L (SRE): Good. Next: SDK guidance content below. Raj, can you push to CDN docs + slack channel? we should also ask customers to set idempotency keys for non-GET operations and to reduce retries from 5 -> 2.
Raj P (Devex): Copying recommended snippet here.

```
// recommended emergency client config
client.configure({
  maxRetries: 2,
  baseDelayMs: 200,
  backoffFactor: 2,
  jitter: true,
  streaming: false, // temporarily disable for long-lived sessions
  enforceIdempotencyHeader: true // if set, SDK will attach X-Idempotency-Key
});
```

Sam L (SRE): Also recommend exponential backoff example (pseudo):

```
retryDelay = baseDelayMs * (backoffFactor ** attempt) + random(0, jitterMs)
```

Raj P (Devex): We'll also provide a minimal server-side idempotency header example for APIs that create items:

```
POST /generate
Headers: { "X-Idempotency-Key": "<uuid-v4>" }
```

Maria G (oncall): Support/Account teams: please message top-tier affected customers directly with the workaround: reduce parallel streams, set idempotency, drop retries.
Aisha (Support): Will do. drafting now. will include step-by-step SDK change + code snippet for curl + node + python.
Devex-Bot: Emergency SDK patch queued: node sdk v3.4.7-hotfix, python sdk 2.8.1-hotfix. Patch changes default maxRetries -> 2 and adds opt-in idempotency header support.
Sam L (SRE): Two small operational notes:
  - If customers cannot add idempotency keys, prefer server-side quota instead of disabling streaming.
  - Avoid immediate aggressive circuit breakers; prefer staged limits to prevent cascading failures.
Maria G (oncall): After cap, we still see some noisy keys. proceeding to disable streaming for top-3 keys at 1784321360. will monitor.
Sam L (SRE): telemetry looks better. 5xx ~1.0% now. queue lengths normalizing.
Raj P (Devex): Released hotfix to CDN + posted advisory in #customers-notices: short blurb + link to SDK emergency config. also added sample retry policy for mobile clients (reduce concurrency max to 1 per device).
Aisha (Support): Customers updated. one customer requested rollback because they rely on streaming for auth flows. we offered targeted exception and working with their engineering lead.
Sam L (SRE): Action items:
  - Raj: publish the emergency SDK advisory + link to sample code (ETA 10m).
  - Maria: keep caps for 2 hours, then ramp down if stable (ETA review 1784322200).
  - Support: compile list of customers needing exceptions.
  - SRE: continue to monitor for 2h and verify 99p latency.
Raj P (Devex): Posted advisory at 1784321420 -> https://internal.docs/sdkguides/emergency-backoff
Maria G (oncall): will hold caps until 1784322200 unless we see regressions. good job team :thumbsup:
Sam L (SRE): leaving notes for post-incident: consider making the SDK changes opt-out rather than opt-in long term, evaluate default streaming chunk size, and add a telemetry flag to detect long-lived streams by token count.
Aisha (Support): I'll consolidate tickets and send summary to CSMs.
Devex-Bot: Incident thread closed for mitigation coordination. create postmortem task in #postmortems when resolved.
Maria G (oncall): closing thread -- moving to postmortem queue. keep monitoring dashboards. :wave:
